decision: MWV is the target work catalogue; obtain a citable catalogue data source before bulk mapping.
Use the Foundation's alphabetical work index for authority-title and year reconciliation; retain revisions and arrangements as separate relationship records.
Use Marcel Marnat catalogue numbering as a reference; the BnF confirms the 1986 print reference, but an online list is not itself a primary authority source.
Use the Library of Congress collection and finding aid for primary-source provenance; do not treat its holdings count as a complete canonical work list.
sourceName: Library of Congress George and Ira Gershwin Collection
